about_the_game:
Please note: This is a pixel game. If your display is large, running the game in default windowed mode will result in better game performance.

Damn! The old man has been kidnapped by aliens, what to do? Finished! The aliens are conducting inhuman experiments on the old man, how to solve it? Click "Add to Cart" to complete the purchase and get the solution!

(If you encounter any bugs, please email getupinthenight@126.com, and the author will fix them immediately. Of course, the game basically has no bugs, you can complete it smoothly, as it has been tested countless times during the EA period.)

 

Unique Style!

Please watch the game trailer!

Are you thinking... the game's art is too simplistic!

This is an indie game made by one person. The game has no outsourcing; all work is done by me alone. In a way, this is a true "indie game."

Don't leave yet, listen to me pleading on my knees: "Although the game's art is simple, it's minimalistic yet not simplistic. With just a few strokes, it captures the characters' spirit, vivid and lifelike on the screen... Alright, if you really don't like the game's art style, I promise, apart from this, the game has no other flaws! The game's music is super good, the game mechanics are super innovative, and the game genre is super diverse. Please buy it, play it, try it~"

 

Massive Creativity!

No kidding, this game truly contains massive creativity. At first, the game is an action-puzzle game, but as you play, subtly and completely in line with the story progression, it transforms into a stat-allocation RPG. Isn't that amazing? No kidding.

 

Exceptionally Rich Plot!

Yes, the biggest highlight of this game is the plot! On the surface, it's a black-humor orthodox sci-fi story, but at its core, it's a story that satirizes reality for fun.

The protagonist of the story is naturally that unlucky old man, but slowly, subtly, just as mentioned in my previous box, completely in line with the story progression, suddenly, the aliens also become playable protagonists... After a while, cosmic monsters also become playable game protagonists.

This game introduces the multiverse concept, so anything is possible in the game, yet everything moves toward a destined ending!

(Welcome to play, I only act cryptic in the description!)

 

Simple Controls

No need for many words, playing with a keyboard can be done entirely with one hand, left or right.

 

Future Updates

"Get Up In The Night" already has three completely different game endings, but is everything really over? Of course not. I will update END4 in the near future. Stay tuned.

Finally, welcome to try the demo, welcome to purchase (orz)!
